recoveryText:
## Recovery bridge and unresolved integration

The class suite's **Retune** formula is the active RP rule for this combined test: recover max(0, floor(maxRP/4 + 0.5) + actual casting modifier), capped at maximum, and clear Dissonance after a completed one-hour short rest. Retain the expedition rule of at most **two beneficial short rests between long rests**, and one beneficial eight-hour long rest per **24 hours**. A long rest restores RP and clears Dissonance; expedition time, supply, pressure, Wounds and rest legality still apply. Count time once, not once in each tracker. Oracle and other non-RP engines use their class-specific recovery, not this formula.

This bridge explicitly chooses the class Retune formula over the gameplay draft's quarter-pool-only RP paragraph. Both originals remain preserved. A completed long rest also resets the remembered spell name and Refrain counter. A short rest clears Dissonance through Retune but does not reset Refrain unless a class feature expressly says so. This reset convention is an explicit provisional decision agreed in the notebook review. Broader recovery decisions for all class resources still require the character/campaign integration pass.

featherFall.targets: Up to 5 willing falling creatures you can perceive within range
featherFall.duration: Until each target lands, stops falling, or 1 minute passes, whichever occurs first
featherFall.resolution: None; willing legal targets are affected automatically.
featherFall.effect: Slow each target's downward descent so it falls no more than 60 feet during each round while the spell remains on that target.
featherFall.scaling: None; maximum descent remains 60 feet per round and target cap remains 5.
featherFall.limitations: Does not grant flight, hovering, lateral movement, immunity to falling consequences, or automatic safe landing beyond whatever the existing falling rules produce from the reduced descent. A creature ceases to be affected once it lands or is no longer falling. Targets cannot be added after casting. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain. This Action spell requires targets that are still falling when your turn allows the cast; it is not a Reaction rescue after an already resolved impact. Fall damage itself remains the existing rule and is not automatically negated.
featherFall.designNotes: Core V2 consistently gives Action, 60-foot range, V/S/F components, and the five-creature/60-feet-per-round source effect, but lists Instantaneous duration despite a sustained descent change. This pilot uses a non-concentration duration until landing or 1 minute as a NEW bounded operational decision and deliberately does not import a Reaction casting time or automatic fall-damage immunity. F is represented as an existing class casting focus.

fallingEvidence: Focused searches of current rulebook extracts, CoreV2 JSON, main and ReviewBible mechanics/manual text found the Feather Fall and Featherstep summaries but no operational descent timing or impact formula. This is search scope, not proof no historical file anywhere has one.
fallingRequest: Please propose a minimal explicitly NEW provisional falling procedure that preserves Feather Fall as an Action spell, permits a clearly defined Action rescue window without retroactively undoing an impact, distinguishes its60ft/round slowing from ordinary fall speed, and resolves landing damage. Exact timing is required, but do not portray invented values as recovered source. We can place it in the spell integration guide as a bounded test rule pending broader combat integration. If this needs a further source check, state which concrete source rather than approve an undefined interface.
